Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.channels

Class VaultMeshChannelsMeshInjectGateway

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.channels.VaultMeshChannelsMeshInjectGateway
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChannelsMeshInjectGateway
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(name="kfe.vaultmesh.enabled", havingValue="true") public class VaultMeshChannelsMeshInjectGateway extends Object implements ChannelsMeshInjectGateway
Mesh CHANNELS inject: soft-reserve → on-chain CHANNELS Taproot PSBT to LND address → openChannel → Intent commit.

CHANNELS uses a dedicated Taproot key (GET /v1/bitcoin/deposit?bucket=CHANNELS), never the USERS omnibus tb1p.

    • VaultMeshChannelsMeshInjectGateway

      public VaultMeshChannelsMeshInjectGateway(com.kerosene.common.vaultmesh.settlement.VaultMeshSettlementPort settlementPort, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<BitcoinCoreRpcClient> bitcoinCoreRpcClient, @Value("${kfe.channel.mesh-inject-fund-conf-target:1}") int fundConfTarget, @Value("${kfe.channel.mesh-inject-fund-max-fee-sats:50000}") long maxFundFeeSats, @Value("${kfe.channel.mesh-inject-fund-fee-rate-sat-vb:0}") long fundFeeRateSatVb)
      Creates the CHANNELS funding gateway and normalizes its fee-selection settings.
      Parameters:
      settlementPort - VaultMesh intent and signing operations
      bitcoinCoreRpcClient - provider for the optional Bitcoin Core RPC client
      fundConfTarget - desired transaction confirmation target, clamped to at least one
      maxFundFeeSats - maximum funding fee in satoshis, clamped to zero or greater
      fundFeeRateSatVb - explicit fee rate, enabled only when positive

    • reserveOpen

      public ChannelsMeshInjectGateway.DebitResult reserveOpen(String intentId, long amountSats, String peerPubkey)
      Reserves CHANNELS capital under the supplied intent and allowlist destination. Recognized duplicate/replay responses are treated as successful idempotent retries.

      Parameters:

      peerPubkey - peer key used by the initial request authorization check

    • fundOpen

      public ChannelsMeshInjectGateway.FundResult fundOpen(String intentId, long amountSats, String lndFundingAddress)
      Builds a fee-capped on-chain funding transaction from the dedicated CHANNELS deposit key, obtains its signature from VaultMesh, finalizes it, and broadcasts it through Bitcoin Core. Address screening here is only a plausibility check; it does not validate a checksum.
      Specified by:
      fundOpen in interface ChannelsMeshInjectGateway
      Parameters:
      intentId - reserved intent identifier used to bind the signing request
      amountSats - amount to send to the LND funding address
      lndFundingAddress - destination address supplied by LND
      Returns:
      funding result containing the broadcast transaction identifier on success

    • releaseOpen

      public ChannelsMeshInjectGateway.InjectResult releaseOpen(String intentId, long amountSats, String peerPubkey)
      Releases a prior CHANNELS reservation after an unsuccessful channel-open workflow. The peer key is not needed by the VaultMesh release operation.
      Specified by:
      releaseOpen in interface ChannelsMeshInjectGateway
      Parameters:
      intentId - reservation identifier to release
      amountSats - amount associated with the reservation
      peerPubkey - peer key retained by the gateway contract but unused for release
      Returns:
      release result or refusal reason
